photos.llama_desc: A group of people, including a man in a suit and a woman in a colorful top, and a girl in a blue t-shirt, holding a large white and green banner with the words "Official Michigan" and "Green School" printed on it, in front of a large screen and an American flag, with a group of children sitting on the floor in front of them.
Two people in graduation attire, one holding a diploma, in front of a clock tower.

A woman sitting on a rock near a body of water. She is wearing a black jacket, white shirt, and light blue jeans, and has long blonde hair. She is sitting on a rock near a body of water, with trees and greenery in the background.

A child in a pink leotard and a pink tutu stands on a red mat in a gymnastics studio, with her arms raised in the air. She is surrounded by a group of children and adults, all of whom are wearing yellow shirts with the letters "G" and "F" on them. The child is standing on a red mat in the center of the room, with a group of children and adults in the background, all of them wearing yellow shirts with the letters "G" and "F" on them.

A child and one adult in a mall or shopping center, looking at a large, green, animatronic dinosaur in a water feature with a fog effect. The child is standing on a rock-like structure, looking at the dinosaur's face, while the adult is standing behind them, looking at the child. The background is a large, open area with a few benches and a food court in the distance.

A person sitting on a bench in a garden with a large planter and a variety of flowers and plants. The person is sitting on a bench in a garden with a large planter and a variety of flowers and plants. The garden is surrounded by a black metal fence and has a few trees and a small pond.

A sheet of white paper on a black metal table. The paper is flat and smooth, with a few tiny creases in the top left corner. The table's metal mesh is visible in the background, with a few shadows cast by the paper's edges.

Five people sitting on a couch in a living room. A woman is holding a baby and a toddler is sitting on her lap, while a boy and a girl are sitting on the couch next to them. The woman is writing in a book and the children are playing with toys and reading books.

A person and a skeleton sitting on a chair in a living room. The person is holding a small stuffed animal and a ball, and the skeleton is wearing a witch's hat and a black cape. The room is decorated with various Halloween and Christmas decorations, including a Christmas tree and a Santa Claus.
A man and a woman. They are standing on a white ceiling with a grid of grey tiles. The man is wearing a dark jacket and a hat.
